prompt: Work out the method signature an IDE's Extract Method refactoring would generate for a selected block. Complete ExtractMethodAnalyzer, then run the tests.
explanation: Extract Method needs a parameter for every value the block consumes from outside, so the analysis is really read/write classification. assignmentTarget recognises a plain assignment by scanning the leading identifier and demanding a single '=' after it -- rejecting "==" is what keeps a comparison from looking like a write, and rejecting "+=" is what makes a compound assignment count as a read. Everything after the '=' is still read, so the method analyses only that part of an assignment line, and containsIdentifier applies the same whole-word rule that stops "totals" from matching "total".
hints: Write two private helpers: one returning the assignment target of a trimmed line (or null), and one testing whether a name appears as a whole identifier in some text.
On an assignment line, only the text AFTER the '=' counts as reads -- substring from indexOf('=') + 1.
Reject the line as an assignment when the character after '=' is another '=' (a comparison), or when the character before it is not a space or identifier character (a compound assignment like +=).
